outlines.title: Adopt a defensible allocation policy for shared cloud services
outlines.objective: Produce a reconciled showback model and internally approved allocation recommendation with consistent finance and engineering ownership instructions. Showback reports allocated costs without posting customer charges.
outlines.decision_problem: Resource tags identify nominal owners, while shared services support several business units and retain capacity for resilience. Assigning costs solely to tagged owners can concentrate shared costs on the platform team; allocating everything by transaction volume can charge consumers for capacity they do not drive. The engineer establishes service relationships, protected capacity and the applicability of usage or entitlement drivers. The analyst reconciles the incurred pool, attributes adjustments and compares supported distributions, including central funding where policy permits. The manager develops the plan, weighs accountability, predictability and driver quality, and chooses the firm's allocation position. The selected rule must reconcile to the same cost pool and change business-unit forecasts and ownership instructions. Outputs include the cost bridge, comparative calculations, allocation policy, revised forecasts and actionable ServiceNow follow-up. All necessary evidence exists initially; customer posting or agreement is not required. Required applications are gmail_mock, slack_mock, google_calendar_mock, google_drive_mock, google_docs_mock, google_sheets_mock and ServiceNow_mock. Attributable planning and specialist collaboration may use any permitted collaboration application rather than an exclusive Slack location.

assumptions: This is a bounded repair of the supplied dossier. The fictional analogue, staffing, workload, customer population, expenditure and history remain synthetic; no new real-firm facts are introduced.

All sourced quotes were checked against the supplied full captured texts. Those supplied captures establish the evidence available for this repair and supersede the prior dossier's statements that the pages were absent from its frozen packet.

The case studies ground capabilities, not the location of delivery staff, UST reporting lines or professional delegations. The modeled US advisory operation is a scenario choice anchored to UST's sourced US presence.

All three workers contribute substantive analysis or decisions in every outline. Worker identities and membership remain stable. The manager receives the objective and creates the plan, including the working sequence.

Accessible onboarding must state: computer-use automation (CUA) means operating applications through their on-screen interface; a virtual machine (VM) is each worker's separate computer environment; Bash is a command-line shell for local digital work. Each participant uses CUA and Bash in a separate personal VM while collaborating through shared applications.

Accessible onboarding and savings-realization initial materials must define Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) before referring to UTC offsets. Historical implementation and performance timestamps retain explicit offsets so workers can compare times correctly.

Every episode includes Gmail, Slack, Google Calendar, Google Drive and Google Docs as mandatory company infrastructure. The corrected shared-cost-allocation construction list contains seven apps: gmail_mock, slack_mock, google_calendar_mock, google_drive_mock, google_docs_mock, google_sheets_mock and ServiceNow_mock. Calendar must also appear in its initial materials and required-app manifest.

Savings-realization and commitment-economics require those seven applications plus aws_console_mock. Required applications must not be silently dropped or substituted. Infrastructure availability does not require an artificial task action in every application.

Discoverable onboarding and episode instructions must permit attributable managerial planning, specialist reports and review through available Slack, Gmail, Google Docs, or linked ServiceNow work notes. Success criteria must accept equivalent attributable collaboration across these permitted locations. They must not require Slack exclusively or prescribe the manager's delegation sequence.

Applications run on separate origins with shared in-app session identity. Access is provided through each virtual machine's application URLs. Do not require server-enforced individual permissions; use explicit worker and role labels plus virtual-machine action attribution. A shared app username alone does not establish authorship or approval.

Frozen schemas were inspected during repair, but no deployed run manifest or runtime interaction evidence was supplied. This dossier establishes a proposed record contract and textual consistency, not verified interface behavior, deployment readiness or demonstrated multi-agent advantage.

Construction must include every documented top-level application state key and no unsupported additions. Before relying on an interaction, verify readable source content, relevant editing, shared persistence and reset behavior on the actual surface. In particular, ServiceNow catalog descriptions and incident sorting, AWS favorites, and historical Calendar navigation remain unverified.

The continuing portfolio remains visible through historical exports, prior recommendations and unresolved obligations. Each episode selects a bounded focal decision from that larger workload rather than presenting its task inventory as the whole company.

Granular billing, utilization, ownership, architecture, demand, commercial terms and completed-change evidence must exist initially. Sparse AWS billing summaries cannot replace the evidence needed for allocation, commitment modeling or savings attribution.

Frozen scenario rates, eligibility rules, cost definitions and demand cases govern each episode. Dated public evidence grounds the business model; episodes do not depend on changing live prices, real staff identities, new web facts or later customer responses.

Internal acceptance of advice is distinct from customer authorization. Operational records preserve pending implementation and existing obligations. No outline requires purchasing, production mutation, accounting posting, a physical event or clock acceleration.

Workers explicitly link and reconcile references across applications. Automatic synchronization, a complete cloud dependency graph and continuous FinOps ingestion are not assumed. UST PACE automation remains a declared gap outside the retained advisory scope.
